$doc: Cosmetics: looks earned by playing (never bought). kind uiTheme: `vars` are CSS custom properties set on the page (accent colours from styles/tokens.css). kind heroOutfit: `colors` override the hero model palette (src/engine/heroView.js keys: coat, coatTrim, vest, pants, cape, capeIn, blade, hilt, glove, boot). `unlock` is one quest-style condition (stat + target, mapsWon, winDifficulty, towerLevel, owned, ownFaction, discovered, summons); no `unlock` means owned from the start. One item per kind is equipped (save.cosmetics). kind projectileFx: every projectile is tinted towards `tint` by `mix` (0-1), so damage types keep a hint of their own colour. kind towerPlinth: the base plate under every tower takes `color`. kind towerSkin: `tint` recolours the whole tower model (mixed in by `strength`, default 0.6); `faction` limits it to Modern War or Magic towers.
